evaluation_blockers.detail: Only three documents have complete reviewed major-section inventories; article and requirement labels are positive samples, so their precision and exhaustive recall are not measurable.
The scanned 37-page Arabic CDC-DEV-009 was processed end-to-end, but its structure labels remain DRAFT and are excluded from accuracy scoring.
Known issuing organizations are heavily concentrated: 20 documents belong to the Presidency of the Government; other source-reviewed organizations are sparse.
